reviews.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended CLIXML parsing drops lowercase warnings and mixed stderr diagnostics, causing incorrect success statuses, and fails to decode valid UTF-16 surrogate pairs.
3 open issues - [Preserve ordinary stderr alongside progress-only CLIXML](https://github.com/OpenAEV-Platform/implant/pull/229#discussion_r4692570530) · New - [Match CLIXML warning stream names case-insensitively](https://github.com/OpenAEV-Platform/implant/pull/229#discussion_r4692570598) · New - [Decode supplementary Unicode from paired UTF-16 escapes](https://github.com/OpenAEV-Platform/implant/pull/229#discussion_r4692570659) · New
What changed in this PR This PR addresses issue #72 by decoding PowerShell CLIXML stderr in the implant’s execution-result handling, making base64-obfuscated payload errors readable. **Changes:** - Extracts error and warning text, decodes XML entities and PowerShell escapes, and drops progress records. - Leaves stdout untouched and preserves ordinary non-CLIXML stderr. - Adds regression coverage for the reported connection error, progress-only output, and ordinary warnings. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `src/​tests/​process/​execution_result_tests.rs` | Adds CLIXML fixtures and assertions for decoded output and result status. | | `src/​common/​execution_result.rs` | Adds CLIXML detection and text decoding before result classification. |
Review effort: Balanced

review_comments.body: A progress-only CLIXML document followed by ordinary stderr, such as a diagnostic from `[Console]::Error.WriteLine`, is converted to an empty string because only matching `<S>` contents are retained. This loses the diagnostic and changes an exit-zero result from warning to success. Preserve non-XML portions, or return the original stderr when the capture is not entirely a complete CLIXML document.

Windows PowerShell serializes `Write-Warning` records with the lowercase stream name `S="warning"`. This case-sensitive check rejects those records, so their text disappears and an exit-zero result becomes `STATUS_SUCCESS` instead of `STATUS_WARNING`. Match the stream names case-insensitively and add a lowercase-warning fixture.

CLIXML escapes represent UTF-16 code units, so a supplementary Unicode character can span two escapes. For example, `_xD83D__xDE00_` represents U+1F600, but `char::from_u32` rejects both surrogate values and leaves the escapes unchanged. Decode valid surrogate pairs together and consume both escapes, while preserving malformed or unpaired escapes.
